frames.prompt:
USE CASE / OUTPUT
Create one production raster frame for celebration / C1.
Output exact 418:418 aspect, one character, flat chroma-key green background, no text.

REFERENCE ROLES
Reference 1 is the active Miffy C1 pose-and-composition contract. Preserve its exact action phase, camera, framing, optical center, negative space, prop location/angle/endpoints, baseline, and padding.
Reference 2 is the identity contract. Replace Miffy with Fenna, the approved fox; preserve the canonical silhouette, face, fixed colors, and wardrobe. Do not blend species or retain rabbit features.

SEMANTIC STATE
anticipation crouch before the reward hop. This is one reviewed frame only, not a generic pose or animation sheet.

STYLE / FRAMING
Use simple flat children's-book color and restrained black linework. Keep the complete character and every required prop uncropped. Match the neighboring frame's apparent scale, line weight, colors, baseline, and composition. Use only flat chroma behind the subject.

INVARIANTS
Keep open warm-ochre vest, blue neckerchief, visible tail, and toe-line marks unchanged. Keep the reward-hop silhouette free of unrelated action props.

AVOID
No Miffy or rabbit identity, pink dress, extra limbs, extra props, flowers, plants, scenery, shadows, text, logo, watermark, border, or droplets beyond the semantic frame.

normalization.method: reviewed raster resize and transparent-canvas translation only

checks: baseline, crop, apparent scale, and prop endpoints
transparent corners, fringe, and complete silhouette
